verifiedRecords.quality: Exact recovery with success at least 15/16 on balanced inputs
verifiedRecords.graph: Both hidden clusters have sizes in [n/3,2n/3]; δ=1/16
verifiedRecords.notes: §5 hard distribution assigns independent fair cluster labels. Balance fails with probability≤2exp(−n/18). Conditioning with success slack preserves the 7/8 distributional lower bound; cached distinct queries bound off-promise work by n². This balanced-promise statement is an explicit elementary corollary, not a literal theorem quotation. A hypothetical o(n log n)-query algorithm is truncated after n² queries, with o(1) extra failure by Markov; off-promise work is then bounded.

verifiedRecords.notes: The two terms retain full δ dependence. This is not unconditional exact recovery of all cluster sizes.
